mapper.sql: id, profile_id, category, name, description, proficiency, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_profile_skill (profile_id, category, name, description, proficiency, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{category}, #{name}, #{description}, #{proficiency}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sr_profile_skill WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY category, sort_order, id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_profile_skill WHERE profile_id = #{profileId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_profile_skill SET category = #{category}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, proficiency = #{proficiency}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
